item.title: Dumped cars, 27th October
item.description:
The car park in windmill close is supposed to be for the residents of windmill and maria close, it is has become a dumping ground for unwanted cars and people who dont live here also use it meaning the residents sometimes dont have anywhere to park their cars! It would be good if there were a permit system for residents or at least a sign saying its a residential car park, there used to be a sign but has disappeared
